rules.description: Checks that deleted records do not exceed 0.1%.
Checks if the MaxDate is the same across all active 2022 StatVars.
Verifies that MaxDate meets the expected freshness threshold for active (2022) and legacy (2010) cohorts.

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MaxDate, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_svs FROM stats
params.condition: (((StatVar LIKE '%80To89Years%' OR StatVar LIKE '%90To99Years%') AND MaxDate >= '2010') OR (StatVar NOT LIKE '%80To89Years%' AND StatVar NOT LIKE '%90To99Years%' AND MaxDate >= '2022')) AND total_svs > 0

rules.description: Verifies that all age-bracket StatVars have the same number of places (33 entities).
